purpose: Corroborate the N-PORT NVIDIA common-stock CUSIP against SEC-filed Schedule 13G name/CUSIP records spanning the basket history; link issuer CIK separately through own original 10-K.
decision_rule: Require exact reported issuer name, common stock title and CUSIP in each filed document. These are third-party security descriptions, not issuer-authored CIK links or proof of each intervening month. Preserve the distinction.
